text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Gambir) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 25 Januari 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit

Gambir yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan, bermula

di kilometer 156.612 di koordinat U 468157.690, T 1133224.234 Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 158.051

di koordinat U 469395.825, T 1132492.661 Grid RSO (GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya Utara

Selatan (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan

di Persimpangan Bertingkat Johor Bahru) termasuklah Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Bukit

Gambir dan jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di koordinat U 467970.217,

T 1132572.615 Grid RSO (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

 (2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BUKIT GAMBIR INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Johore, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Bukit Gambir

Interchange) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 25 January 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Bukit Gambir Interchange which is a

part of the North South Expressway, commencing at kilometre 156.612 at coordinates

N 468157.690, E 1133224.234 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 158.051 at coordinates N 469395.825,

E 1132492.661 of the RSO (GDM 2000) Grid of the North South Expressway (both

distances measured from kilometre 0.0 of the North South Expressway at the Johore

Bahru Interchange) including the Bukit Gambir Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link road

and ending at coordinates N 467970.217, E 1132572.615 of the RSO (GDM 2000) Grid,

is declared to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
